words.narration: include，in 表示里面。小黑把橙色餐盘收进盒子，再合上盖子，餐盘成为整体的一部分。现代英语里，include 就是包括。The price includes breakfast，价格包含早餐。这里说的是费用包含什么，不需要真的有一个盒子。
words.action: 小黑把餐盘收进盒子，再合上盖子；餐盘成为整体的一部分。
states: One solid-black worker stands left of a small open pale-blue lunch box and holds one orange plate outside it. The lid is upright, box only half the character height.
The same worker lowers the same orange plate halfway into the same open lunch box; lid, box, camera and character scale unchanged.
The same worker has placed the plate fully inside the same box and closes the lid; one hand rests on the closed lid. No plate remains outside.

words.narration: exclude，ex 表示外面。这次小黑合上盒子，把餐盘留在外面，就是不包括。The price excludes breakfast，价格不含早餐。include 和 exclude 放进同一个句子，早餐算不算在费用里，答案正好相反。
words.action: 小黑合上盒子，把橙色餐盘留在外面，表示不纳入整体。
states: One solid-black worker stands left of a small open pale-blue box. One orange plate lies clearly outside the box on its right. Worker holds the lid open.
Same worker starts closing the lid of the same box while the orange plate stays outside, untouched on the right.
Same worker firmly holds the closed lid. The same orange plate is still clearly outside on the right, excluded from the box.

words.example: We concluded that the plan was workable.
words.translation: 我们得出结论：方案可行。
words.narration: conclude 带着合拢、收束的词源线索。小黑整理完桌上的材料，合上文件夹，讨论告一段落。它可以表示结束，也可以表示得出结论。We concluded that the plan was workable，我们得出结论，方案可行。conclude that 后面接完整的判断。
words.action: 小黑收齐材料并合上文件夹，以讨论收束助记结束和得出结论。
states: One solid-black worker faces a small open orange folder on a short pale-blue desk. Two blank cream sheets are beside the folder; worker reaches for them.
Same worker gathers the two blank sheets inside the same open orange folder on the same desk.
Same worker presses the same orange folder closed on the same desk. The two sheets are inside. Calm resolved posture, no text or symbols.

words.translation: 大雨使户外活动无法进行。
words.narration: preclude，pre 表示在前。小黑在球滚过去之前，关上小闸门，通路被堵住。这个画面用来记阻止、使不可能。Heavy rain precluded outdoor activities，大雨使户外活动无法进行。留意 preclude someone from doing something，表示使某人无法做某事。
words.action: 小黑在球通过之前关上局部小闸门，把通路堵住，助记阻止发生。
states: One solid-black worker stands next to a small hand-drawn orange hinged gate on a short blue ground line, gate open. One small orange ball sits well before the gate. Gate lower than the worker shoulders.
Same worker swings the same small gate shut across the local path. Same ball is closer but has not crossed the gate.
Same worker holds the small gate fully closed. The orange ball is stopped on the near side, path beyond remains empty. Keep the worker dominant and gate subordinate.

words.narration: seclude，se 带着分开、离开的意思。小黑把自己的小阅读角用帘子隔开，安静独处。seclude 是使隔离、使独处，日常更容易遇到形容词 secluded，比如 a secluded village，一个僻静的村庄。它强调远离人群，不能直接等同于排除名单。
words.action: 小黑拉起阅读角的帘子，将自己与外界隔开，助记独处、僻静。
states: One solid-black worker sits holding a small blank orange book on a low stool. A small pale-blue curtain is gathered on the right of the reading nook; worker holds its cord.
Same worker pulls the curtain halfway across the same reading nook. Keep eyes, book, stool and body visible; thin hand-drawn curtain, not a huge panel.
Same worker sits quietly with the orange book inside a partly enclosed nook, curtain drawn to the side leaving a generous opening with face and body visible. No extra person.
